lines.text: In choosing carriers, employers value integrated absence management experiences more
QUESTION: Imagine your company was selecting a carrier for a new disability insurance benefit.
Which of the following would you choose?
A carrier that provides an integrated absence management program along with its disability product — for a higher price
A carrier with the best-value disability product even without an integrated, real-time absence management service
